subject: history
concept: Understanding how a community group can work together to solve a local problem
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Tokkatsu-style group-decision principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student participates in a simple simulated town-hall discussion about a small local problem
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a local problem to a possible community solution
exercise.abstract: Student proposes one way a community could work together to solve a described problem

misconception_flags: proposes a solution requiring only one person to act rather than genuine community cooperation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
